# Agentic Tools

> Free, browser-based tools for the AI-agent era. No signup, no upload — everything runs client-side. For merchants and developers preparing for AI agents, AI search and the Model Context Protocol.

## Tools
- [AI robots.txt generator](/ai-robots-txt-generator): allow or block GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended and more
- [Product schema generator](/product-schema-generator): schema.org Product + Offer JSON-LD for AI shopping agents
- [FAQ schema generator](/faq-schema-generator): schema.org FAQPage JSON-LD
- [MCP client config generator](/mcp-config-generator): Claude / Cursor config for a remote MCP server
- [XML sitemap generator](/xml-sitemap-generator): turn a list of URLs into a valid sitemap.xml with lastmod, changefreq, priority
- [Meta & Open Graph generator](/meta-tag-generator): title, meta description, canonical, Open Graph and Twitter Card tags
- [ACP product feed converter](/acp-feed-converter): convert a Google-Merchant-style CSV into an Agentic Commerce Protocol (ChatGPT Shopping) JSONL feed with validation
- [MCP Server Card generator](/mcp-server-card-generator): build a /.well-known/mcp/server-card.json manifest for a Model Context Protocol server
- [ai-catalog.json generator](/ai-catalog-generator): build an Agentic Resource Discovery /.well-known/ai-catalog.json listing MCP servers, agents and APIs
- [A2A Agent Card generator](/a2a-agent-card-generator): build an Agent2Agent /.well-known/agent-card.json so other agents can discover and call yours
- [JSON-LD rich results checker](/json-ld-rich-results-checker): paste schema.org JSON-LD and see which types still earn rich results in 2026 vs deprecated ones (FAQPage, HowTo)
- [Agent discovery (well-known) checker](/well-known-checker): live server-side check of a site's ai-catalog.json, MCP server-card.json, A2A agent-card.json, llms.txt, agents.md + AI-crawler access

## Related
- [AgentReady](https://agentready.agiscorecard.com): AI sales-visibility scanner (+ llms.txt generator)
- [MCP Pulse](https://mcppulse.agiscorecard.com): MCP server health scanner
- [Agent Glossary](https://glossary.agiscorecard.com): plain-English definitions for the AI-agent era

## Machine-payable APIs
- [x402 APIs](https://x402.agiscorecard.com): agents can pay per call in USDC via the x402 protocol ($0.005/call, no account) for site and MCP scans

## Machine discovery
- [ai-catalog.json](/.well-known/ai-catalog.json): Agentic Resource Discovery manifest of this site's checker API, generators and sister services
